name: BeenVerified

steps.text: BeenVerified needs you to pick your listing. Go to beenverified.com/svc/optout/search, search for {full_name} in {state_name}, click your own record and solve the CAPTCHA. On the removal form choose "No" for having an account, check your details, and enter {contact_email} as the email address. BeenVerified allows one opt-out per email address, and this one is only for this opt-out. OpenOptOut will click the confirmation link BeenVerified emails to it.

source: Flow and selectors from Blake104/OptOut (AGPL-3.0) beenverified.yml, verified upstream 2026-05-10; one opt-out per email address and the emailed confirmation link per BADBOOL's BeenVerified entry.
notes: BeenVerified shows search results and a CAPTCHA before the removal form, so a person picks the record. The steps after the pause are kept for when the app can hand a live browser to a person and resume. The state picker is a Material UI list (full state names). A separate opt-out exists for property search: beenverified.com/app/optout/address-search. One opt-out also covers PeopleLooker and PeopleSmart.
